pcb.geometry: Actual unrouted tscircuit PCB and its component placement, inside native assembly.device; supplied component OBJ models where available. Drawing-derived bodies remain approximate. DNP copper test pads appear in the PCB surface texture with no artificial component bodies.
pcb.routing: No copper routing. Wires in this assembly are external connection illustrations.

peltier.description: HiLetgo TEC1-12706 2-pack; the board drives one module
peltier.geometry: Amazon listing dimensional envelope, not manufacturer CAD. Ceramic plates and core are visual approximations; lead routing, diameter and length are illustrative. Confirm purchased samples before mechanical manufacture.

officialCadAttempts.result: Manufacturer offers CAD through TraceParts; no downloadable mesh obtained. Board uses the exact-part EasyEDA supplier mesh, which is not claimed to be manufacturer-authored.
Manufacturer-linked CAD export requires registered authorization. Use TI RYQ0021A drawing-derived 5 x 3 x 1 mm maximum-height package envelope where no supplier mesh is present.

No manufacturer CAD or selected-SKU housing drawing located. The primary product page is sparse and contains lead-color variants; the selected Amazon SKU is the authority for its cable length/color map. Housing remains an explicitly illustrative envelope.

assemblyLimitations: Connection and packaging visualization only. No heatsink, cold plate, clamping mechanism or thermal interface is specified by this assembly. Do not power a bare Peltier without an appropriate hot-side thermal assembly.

usbCables.description: Two Cable Matters 201440 USB-C to USB-C USB 2.0 data / 240 W / 5 A cables, 1 m option

roles.role: PD power from 100 W USB-C charger

usbCables.electricalRating: Manufacturer specifies up to 48 V / 5 A power delivery, an E-Marker, and USB 2.0 data up to 480 Mbps. Both roles can use this same cable product. Board data speed is determined by its USB implementation.
usbCables.geometry: Connection illustrations. Only short segments and board-side plugs are shown. Manufacturer does not publish plug/jacket CAD or dimensions; shapes and role colors are indicative, not fit-qualified geometry. Cable slack, charger end and PC end are omitted.

nativeAssembly.geometry: Native assembly.device + nine literal CAD-only assembly.part models; no accessory PCB components, electrical ports or JLCPCB BOM entries. The supported assembly.cable API cannot resolve generic assembly.part or loose-wire ends, so native JSCAD parts show the external paths. Board-side XY points derive from the real shared connector placements and exact supplier-footprint insertion/pin offsets. Probe cable polygons preserve the three vendor lead colors. Cable/mating heights, diameters and probe housing dimensions are explicitly illustrative.

temperatureProbes.description: Two HiLetgo DS18B20 wired stainless probes, from the selected five-pack
temperatureProbes.housingDimensionEvidence: The selected Amazon listing provides cable length and lead colors, but no verified metal-housing dimensions. Package dimensions and specifications for other sellers are not used as probe dimensions.
temperatureProbes.geometry: Native CAD-only probe parts use explicitly illustrative diameter 6 mm by length 50 mm metal cylinders, not verified seller dimensions or manufacturer CAD. Factory cable length 1 m and red VCC / yellow DATA / black GND follow the selected Amazon listing. Only short jacket paths and three colored conductor fanouts are shown. Jacket diameter 3 mm, conductor diameter 0.7 mm, wire-channel height 3 mm and routing are illustrative and not fit-qualified.
temperatureProbes.placement: HOT is shown near the upper TEC face and COLD near the opposite lower face, laterally offset so both can be inspected. These positions illustrate roles; actual thermal contact, clamps and module face orientation must be established in the physical thermal assembly.
